text:
lin: hey team — trying to follow the terraform quickstart to create a workspace and make the first SDK call but getting 402 Payment Required from the API after workspace creation. added a card in the console already. anyone seen this?
ari: hm, did the console show the org as active? sometimes the billing UI step is separate from card entry.
lin: console shows workspace provisioned + card added. API call error: 
```
HTTP/1.1 402 Payment Required
{
  "error": "workspace_not_activated",
  "message": "Workspace requires billing contact verification before API access"
}
```
maya: that message is new to me — did you create the workspace via terraform or via the console?
lin: terraform. the provider used `redwood_workspace` resource (v0.3). quickstart used the example that auto-creates an org+workspace.
devex: FYI we pushed a small change last week: orgs created by infra tools now need an explicit billing contact confirmation step to reduce accidental charge exposure. sorry if the quickstart example didn't make that clear.
lin: ah ok. what is the confirmation step? can it be done via API so CI can finish provisioning?
devex: yes — two options: 1) go to Console > Billing and click "Confirm billing contact" (manual), or 2) call the billing confirm endpoint in infra flows. example: 
```bash
curl -X POST "https://console.redwood.inference/api/v1/orgs/<ORG_ID>/billing/confirm" \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_ADMIN_TOKEN' \ 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ 
  -d '{"contact_email":"ops+infra@example.com","accepted_terms":true}'
```
lin: GREAT, thanks. is that documented anywhere? quickstart terraform should probably run that automatically for dev orgs.
devex: agreed — filing a followup to update the TF module and quickstart doc. for CI you can set an org-level flag as a temporary bypass: `billing_verification_override=true` on the provider config (only allowed for sandbox orgs). we try not to expose that widely.
taylor: tagging billing for followup: @billing-bot can you confirm whether the console UX for this is discoverable?
billing-bot: Billing hold detected for org <ORG_ID>. Current state: PENDING_CONTACT_CONFIRMATION. To resolve: confirm billing contact via console or API. No invoice issued yet. If you need a permanent bypass for automated infra, open a ticket with billing-team@redwood.com.
lin: thanks — worked after API confirm call. first SDK call now returns 200. documenting workaround in our infra repo. :tada:
ari: nice! devex — please add a note in the quickstart readme and maybe add a small Terraform post-create step in the example.
devex: on it — will push a quick PR to the examples repo and add a warning in the setup flow. leaving this thread open until the doc PR lands.
lin: appreciated, leaving this thread as the record of what I did.
ari: thanks for filing the PR. :+1:
